title: Steam Frame review: comfortable to wear, supports multiple ways to play games, but it doesn't feel like a finished product and has an up to 2-hour battery life (Sean Hollister/The Verge)
summary: Sean Hollister / The Verge: Steam Frame review: comfortable to wear, supports multiple ways to play games, but it doesn't feel like a finished product and has an up to 2-hour battery life — For nearly three weeks, I've been testing the limits of Valve's Steam Frame, the company's new wearable PC.
